company.name: RapidClaims
company.shortDescription: RapidClaims offers an AI powered coding and billing platform that helps healthcare professionals to automate their revenue cycles.
company.description: RapidClaims delivers a platform that combines artificial intelligence with healthcare revenue cycle workflows to streamline billing operations. It automates tasks such as medical coding, claim scrubbing, and clinical documentation improvement through modules like RapidCode™, RapidScrub™, and RapidCDI™. The system applies configurable payer rules and AI assistants to structure and validate claims before submission, helping reduce errors and support compliance. It integrates with existing health record systems, allowing client teams to retain oversight while routine tasks are handled with AI guidance. R
